composition: open upper field, dense lower frieze
description: A large top-down warplane line drawing fills the upper field on open white paper, flanked by yellow vertical bands. Below, a tight frieze of small objects — perforated dot rows, a gold honeycomb panel with a turquoise star, a football, two silver discs and a target.
title: Drafting Table

composition: axial totem on dotted ground, dense base pile
description: A central top-down warplane carries iridescent discs as wheels and propellers on a perforated pegboard ground. A dense pile of additional discs, target rings, ink splashes and torn map fragments crowds the base, framed above by yellow vertical ribbons.
title: Float

composition: diagonal cascade of discs over central plane
description: Three silver compact discs cascade down a gold-foil ground over a top-down line drawing of a single-engine warplane. Strips of red lettering and small game-target stickers line the upper edge; the surface is densely worked, with overlapping foils and crease marks.
title: Untitled (Three Discs Descending)
Untitled (Numan Collage)
description: Mixed-media collage dominated by a bold horizontal red band bearing white cut-leaf forms, above a dense lower zone of silver foil, compact discs, orange triangles, black geometric shapes, and scattered red fragments. Handwritten inscription 'NUMAN' appears at upper right; signed and dated 11/30/2022 at lower right.
composition: horizontal red band over fragmented lower zone

title: Face with Five Discs
description: White translucent paper forms a mask-like face centered on a densely layered collage ground of red, yellow, and silver fragments. Five iridescent compact discs serve as eyes and forehead elements, while a black floppy-disc-like square anchors the mouth area.
composition: central mask face on collaged border

title: Guernica London Spain
description: Mixed-media collage featuring multiple warplane silhouettes in side and top-down views, surrounded by concentric target rings, compact discs, and handwritten text including 'GUERNICA', 'LONDON', and 'SPAIN'. Orange tape strips, black ink lines, and a central framed white panel anchor the layered composition.
composition: central framed panel with peripheral warplane clusters

title: Merry Christmas 2013
description: Vertical collage on white ground features two top-down warplane silhouettes, scattered compact discs, and yellow vertical stripes. Handwritten text reading 'Merry Christmas 2013' anchors the lower edge alongside a row of concentric-ring motifs.
composition: scattered elements across tall vertical ground

title: Untitled (Collage with Targets)
description: Dense mixed-media collage incorporating multiple target rings, compact discs, American footballs, printed text fragments, and a small inset photograph of a red automobile. Handwritten names appear in the lower left corner alongside layered paper ephemera, yellow cardboard framing, and ink markings across a white ground.
composition: dense layered fragments across white ground
keywords: mixed-media collage with football and targets

title: Buy Me (Chess)
description: Dense mixed-media collage dated 3/7/12 incorporates chess pieces, archery targets, a football, and handwritten text reading "BUY ME" across a layered ground of torn paper, yellow tape, and painted marks. Red cross motifs, concentric-ring bullseyes, and black ink outlines accumulate across a white-dominant surface framed in black.
composition: dense layered accumulation across horizontal plane
keywords: yellow tape cross marks layered collage

title: Untitled (Planes and Targets)
description: Mixed-media collage on white paper featuring two top-down warplane silhouettes aligned vertically along a central axis of stacked compact discs and ribbon stripes. Soccer ball, bullseye targets, concentric spiral motifs, and scattered perforated dots populate the surrounding white ground.
composition: vertical axis with scattered peripheral elements
keywords: soccer ball and compact disc mixed media

title: Installation View, Andrea Allison
description: Wide horizontal installation panorama of a gallery wall hung with two large patterned collage panels in red, white, and target rings. The gallery name 'ANDREA ALLISON' appears on the right wall; warm interior light across the long view.

title: Embracing Lovers
description: A pale street wall hosts a loose orange-and-black mural of two embracing figures painted in continuous-line gesture, with red accents marking face and hands. A Mr. Snowmann stands at left wearing a Pierrot hat; a snowman trio anchors the lower-left base. Signed 'Ricky Bird'.
composition: central figure mural with snowman witnesses

title: Red Meerkat, Snowman
description: A standing red-painted meerkat dominates a brick wall against a lurid yellow-and-black sunset. A small Mr. Snowmann figure with hat and glasses stands to the right at the same horizon line; a snowman tag and 'OSCH' signature mark the lower left.
composition: central tall figure on landscape wall

title: Lehrjahre Face
description: A street wall layered in paste-ups and tags: a black-and-white dripping face poster reading 'LEHRJAHRE' anchors the centre, surrounded by torn papers, green and red spray-paint gestures and a small Mr. Snowmann at lower left.
composition: central paste-up face on layered tag wall

title: Car Park, Snowman Cat
description: An urban street view: a 'CAR PARK' arrow sign on the left, a wheat-pasted black-and-white cat-face mural over a building entrance at centre, and a row of three Mr. Snowmann figures riding a small platform at upper left. A red car is parked in the foreground.
composition: central paste-up over urban entrance

title: Yellow Mountains, Snowman
description: A brick archway frames a tall yellow-and-black mural of triangular mountain forms layered with patterned circles, spirals and zigzag fills. A small Mr. Snowmann with arms raised crowns the upper right; a dense decorative woodcut feel.
composition: central archway mural, patterned mountain field

title: Rifle Stencil, Snowman
description: A black wall hosts a stenciled standing figure holding an AK-47 above the painted text 'BENNAZ'. A small Mr. Snowmann with hat and glasses sits at upper centre; a yellow comic-book skyscraper paste-up on the right edge punctuates the dark wall.
composition: central rifle stencil with text and snowman icon

title: Hot Pink Tag, Snowman Trio
description: A dense graffitied wall with overlapping spray tags in turquoise, magenta, white and black. A small white snowman trio is tucked into the centre of the field; the saturated, illegible mass of letters reads as collective noise.
composition: all-over graffiti field with central snowman trio

title: Dance Club Records
description: A red brick wall painted with a large blue spray-painted skull above a stenciled black panel reading 'DANCE CLUB RECORDS'. A row of three white snowmen stands at left; a black and white linocut eye-and-tear motif occupies the lower-right.
composition: central skull with text panel on red brick

title: TEAR Figure
description: A black linocut-style street paste-up of a tall figure in striped clothing, tears falling on small black-and-white labels reading 'TEAR'. A stripe-faced head crowns the figure; the wall behind is a deep blue. A solitary, mournful, woodcut feel.
composition: central tall paste-up on blue wall

title: Two Faces, Snowman Field
description: A pale street wall with two stenciled faces in black and blue spray, one with a red ball-eye, the other in profile. A scatter of small Mr. Snowmann figures fills the lower register, alongside a black radial-rayed skull motif. Loose, sketched, character-driven.
composition: stencil cluster on wall, snowman scatter base

title: How Will This Benefit Me
description: A brown-painted door dense with paste-ups and tags. A blue-faced military figure in epaulettes and skull-cap hat occupies the lower centre with the painted question 'How will this benefit me?' beside it. A snowman icon and various stickers crowd the upper register.
composition: central paste-up with text on tagged door

title: Sticker Door
description: A red door divided into upper and lower panels: dense saturated stickers crowd the upper window — 'CODEFC', 'METRO', 'OLE', 'ABOVE' tags layered to white-out. Below, a stenciled black-line face with a red ankh, a small black tuxedoed figure, and the painted phrase 'ALONE' frame the lower glass.
composition: two-panel red door with stickers above, stencil below

title: No More Poor Doors
description: A Mr. Snowmann paste-up on a blue painted utility box: three white snowmen on a red panel above a black silhouette holding a placard reading 'NO MORE POOR DOORS'. Sticker remnants and 'CLYDE P' tag flank the lower edges; brick wall background.
composition: central paste-up on blue utility box

title: Wall and Pavement, Snowmen
description: Two-register street photograph: above, a cubist red, white and blue paste-up reading 'CARRIER' and 'EAR' with stylised faces in linocut style; below, a cream pavement covered in black graffiti tags hosts three small white Mr. Snowmann figures in spread formation.
composition: two-register: paste-up wall above, tagged pavement below

title: Reaper, Snowman
description: A street stencil of a hooded skull-faced reaper with a small ankh at its chest, on a dark spray-painted wall. A row of three Mr. Snowmann snowmen with raised arms occupies the upper-left, anchoring the composition.
composition: central reaper stencil with snowman row at upper left

title: You Call It God
description: A street paste-up of a black-stenciled creature holding a large white sign reading 'YOU CALL IT GOD WE CALL IT A PRANK' in red block letters. A small Mr. Snowmann tag with snowman icon sits at lower left; tag 'MEME' at right edge.
composition: central paste-up with text sign on cream wall

title: Stencil Girl, Brick Wall
description: A black-and-white stencil of a young girl holding a doily-patterned object is sprayed on a weathered yellow brick wall. Two small Mr. Snowmann tags and a spray-can stencil mark the upper edge of the wall.
composition: central stencil on brick wall

title: Occupy Democracy
description: A black wall beside a white Georgian door (no. 178A) hosts a tall yellow paste-up of a crowned figure with 'occupydemocracy' tags repeated alongside. Two small Mr. Snowmann tags and a stencil signature mark the door frame; a black-line owl mural sweeps across the lower right.
composition: central paste-up beside Georgian doorway

title: Rhode, White Figure
description: A black exterior wall hosts a tall white painted nude figure pasted up beneath yellow spray-painted text reading 'RHODE'. A cartoon Mr. Snowmann tag sits at left; a wide-eyed character and small running figure are tagged at lower left.
composition: central pasted figure on dark wall
